name: @calternal/description
description: The web renderer of the plugin API v2 description contract (docs/description-contract.md): typed model generated from the sealed schemas, the wire client, windowed lists and the Svelte components that draw a description. No app-specific code.

scripts.harness:build: npm run tokens -w @calternal/ui && mkdir -p harness/public/wallpapers && cp -f ../../apps/web/public/wallpapers/EX_STserBZM.jpg harness/public/wallpapers/ 2>/dev/null; vite build -c vite.harness.config.ts
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:keys && npm run e2e:fixtures && npm run e2e:components && npm run e2e:perf
